units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:24">Targ. Prov. XVII, 24</cite> (Var. <cite ref="H01573"><he>חרין</he></cite>, incorr.).—Y. Snh. IV, 23ᶜ bot. <he>לבושי מאנין נקיים חדי</he> (read: <he>נקיי וחדיי</he>) dressed in clean and glossy garments (in spite of the rain, v. Rashi to <cite ref="Sanhedrin 44b:8">Snh. 44ᵇ</cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> top <he>הווי עמכין חדיי</he> (corr. acc.).
Yalk. Is. 289 (transl. עליזה, Is. XXII, 2), v. חֲדָאָה a. דַּחְיָיא.—Pl. חַדְיֵי (abstr. noun) joy. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3), opp. נְסִיס.
